hypotheses.statement: Service checkout selector requires app=checkout and track=canary, but EndpointSlice has zero endpoints and observed workload labels show only app=checkout, so canary pods may not.
503s began after a release, suggesting possible application regression, but empty EndpointSlice means no endpoints receive traffic, so pod-level failure is not currently evidenced.

missing_evidence: Pod labels and readiness for app=checkout workloads to confirm track=canary selection
Application logs or error details to distinguish selection failure from in-pod regression
